name: limpet
description: Stops your agent from stopping too early. Plain-language rules, judged by jev in 0.7 s.

typesafe_api_key.title: TypeSafe API key
typesafe_api_key.description: Calls jev directly. Get one at https://console.typesafe.ai/keys. Leave empty if you use Vercel AI Gateway instead.

ai_gateway_api_key.title: Vercel AI Gateway key
ai_gateway_api_key.description: Calls jev through Vercel AI Gateway (https://vercel.com/ai-gateway). Leave empty if you use a TypeSafe key.

block.title: Block thresholds
block.description: Leave empty for shadow mode (log only). "0.8" for every rule, or "substring of rule=0.5,other rule=0.6".
